  children={"Restore this instance from a remote"}

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/restore_instance"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Replaces every setting, user, role, project and template group on
this grid with what's in the remote instance repository. A fully
destructive, one-shot action with no merge and no undo; the interface is
expected to have the operator confirm that before this is ever called.

Authenticates with the instance's backup SSH key, the same way a backup
push does, rather than with the acting user's own key - restoring the
whole grid is an instance-level operation, not a personal one.

Requires **Backup settings**, and also **Server settings**, since the
restore is only actually finished once the follow-up restart_grid call
succeeds and that route needs **Server settings** itself - the one role
that can trigger a restore should be guaranteed able to complete it.
